e: I still haven't found my key.
I haven't asked for his address yet.

q: أَنَا لَمْ ___ سَمَكًا نِيئًا فِي حَيَاتِي.
e: I have never eaten raw fish in my life.

q: أَنَا لَمْ ___ هَذَا وَحْدِي، سَاعَدَنِي أَخِي.
e: I didn't do this alone, my brother helped me.
I didn't call the manager yesterday.
I haven't bought a present for my sister yet.
I didn't sleep well because of the noise.
I didn't send you any photo.

q: يَا فَادِي، لِمَاذَا لَمْ ___ مَعَنَا أَمْسِ؟
e: Fadi, why didn't you come with us yesterday?

q: أَنْتَ لَمْ ___ لِي كَيْفَ حَدَثَ هَذَا.
e: You didn't explain to me how this happened.

q: يَا بَاسِمُ، أَنْتَ لَمْ ___ ثِيَابَكَ بَعْدُ.
e: Basim, you haven't got dressed yet.

q: أَنْتَ لَمْ ___ مِنْ سَرِيرِكَ طَوَالَ الْيَوْمِ!
e: You haven't got out of bed all day!

q: يَا نَبِيلُ، لِمَاذَا لَمْ ___ هَذِهِ الْجَامِعَةَ؟
e: Nabil, why didn't you choose this university?
My friend, you haven't forgotten your promise.

q: أَنْتَ لَمْ ___ فِي الْمَطْبَخِ مُنْذُ شَهْرٍ.
e: You haven't cooked in the kitchen for a month.

q: يَا سَامِرُ، لِمَاذَا لَمْ ___ ثَمَنَ التَّذَاكِرِ؟
e: Samer, why didn't you pay for the tickets?
Rasha, why didn't you eat your breakfast?

q: أَنْتِ لَمْ ___ لِي شَيْئًا عَنْ رِحْلَتِكِ.
e: You didn't tell me anything about your trip.

q: يَا عُلَا، لِمَاذَا لَمْ ___ فِي الْمُسَابَقَةِ؟
e: Ola, why didn't you take part in the competition?

q: أَنْتِ لَمْ ___ النَّافِذَةَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَخْرُجِي.
e: You didn't close the window before you went out.

q: يَا هِبَةُ، لِمَاذَا لَمْ ___ إِلَى الطَّبِيبِ؟
e: Hiba, why didn't you go to the doctor?

q: أَنْتِ لَمْ ___ فِي الْبَحْرِ هَذَا الصَّيْفَ.
e: You didn't swim in the sea this summer.
Samar, you haven't changed at all.

q: يَا أُخْتِي، أَنْتِ لَمْ ___ بِأُمِّكِ مُنْذُ أُسْبُوعٍ.
e: Sister, you haven't called your mother for a week.

q: يَا لَمْيَاءُ، لِمَاذَا لَمْ ___ الْعَشَاءَ لِلضُّيُوفِ؟
e: Lamya, why didn't you cook dinner for the guests?
Nuha, why didn't you take the bus?
You didn't wash your hair today.
The manager hasn't replied to my email yet.
My brother hasn't got his driving licence yet.
The child didn't eat his food.
Our neighbour hasn't sold his car yet.
The engineer hasn't repaired our fridge yet.

q: هُوَ لَمْ ___ لَنَا شَيْئًا عَنْ خُطَطِهِ.
e: He didn't tell us anything about his plans.
My father hasn't got off the train yet.
The shopkeeper didn't give the customer his change.
Omar hasn't ridden his bike for a year.
My mother hasn't come back from the market yet.
My friend didn't find a job after university.
The doctor hasn't arrived yet, wait a little.

q: هِيَ لَمْ ___ كَلِمَةً وَاحِدَةً طَوَالَ الْعَشَاءِ.
e: She didn't say a single word all through dinner.
My grandmother never studied at a school.

q: الْقِطَّةُ لَمْ ___ مِنْ تَحْتِ السَّرِيرِ طَوَالَ الْيَوْمِ.
e: The cat didn't come out from under the bed all day.

q: سَلْمَى لَمْ ___ بِعِيدِ مِيلَادِهَا هَذِهِ السَّنَةَ.
e: Salma didn't celebrate her birthday this year.
The teacher didn't let us go out.
She never lost hope.

q: نَحْنُ لَمْ ___ هَذَا الْمَطْعَمَ مِنْ قَبْلُ.
e: We haven't been to this restaurant before.

q: نَحْنُ لَمْ ___ شَيْئًا عَنْ هَذَا الْخَبَرِ.
e: We haven't heard anything about this news.

q: نَحْنُ لَمْ ___ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ طَوَالَ الْعُطْلَةِ.
e: We didn't leave the house all holiday.

q: أَنَا وَزَوْجِي لَمْ ___ مُنْذُ عَشْرِ سَنَوَاتٍ.
e: My husband and I haven't travelled for ten years.

q: نَحْنُ لَمْ ___ بَعْدُ أَيْنَ سَنَقْضِي الْعُطْلَةَ.
e: We haven't decided yet where we will spend the holiday.
We haven't paid for the room yet.
We didn't buy enough food for the party.

q: نَحْنُ لَمْ ___ أَصْدِقَاءَنَا الْقُدَامَى مُنْذُ سَنَوَاتٍ.
e: We haven't seen our old friends for years.
Children, why didn't you drink the milk?
You didn't tell me the truth.

q: يَا شَبَابُ، لِمَاذَا لَمْ ___ فِي الْحَفْلَةِ؟
e: Guys, why didn't you dance at the party?
You haven't washed your clothes for a week.

q: يَا طُلَّابُ، لِمَاذَا لَمْ ___ الْقَوَاعِدَ الْجَدِيدَةَ؟
e: Students, why haven't you learnt the new grammar?
You didn't win the prize this time.

q: يَا أَصْدِقَائِي، لَمْ ___ الْمَكَانَ بِسُهُولَةٍ، أَلَيْسَ كَذَلِكَ؟
e: My friends, you didn't find the place easily, did you?
Didn't you hear the bell?

q: يَا أَوْلَادُ، لِمَاذَا لَمْ ___ مَعَ أَبِيكُمْ إِلَى السُّوقِ؟
e: Children, why didn't you go to the market with your father?

q: يَا جَمَاعَةُ، لِمَاذَا لَمْ ___ الْعَشَاءَ مَعَنَا؟
e: Everyone, why didn't you eat dinner with us?

q: يَا طُلَّابُ، أَنْتُمْ لَمْ ___ الْمُعَلِّمَ إِلَى الْحَفْلِ.
e: Students, you didn't invite the teacher to the party.

q: يَا أَوْلَادُ، لِمَاذَا لَمْ ___ النَّافِذَةَ؟ الْجَوُّ حَارٌّ.
e: Children, why didn't you open the window? It is hot.
The guests haven't arrived yet.

q: هُمْ لَمْ ___ فَاتُورَةَ الْكَهْرَبَاءِ مُنْذُ شَهْرَيْنِ.
e: They haven't paid the electricity bill for two months.

q: الْأَطْفَالُ لَمْ ___ مِنَ الْبَحْرِ طَوَالَ الصَّبَاحِ.
e: The children didn't come out of the sea all morning.

q: أَصْدِقَائِي لَمْ ___ الْفِيلْمَ، قَالُوا إِنَّهُ مُمِلٌّ.
e: My friends didn't like the film, they said it was boring.

q: الطُّلَّابُ لَمْ ___ أَيَّ سُؤَالٍ فِي الْمُحَاضَرَةِ.
e: The students didn't ask any questions in the lecture.

q: هُمْ لَمْ ___ عَنْ سَيَّارَةٍ جَدِيدَةٍ بَعْدُ.
e: They haven't looked for a new car yet.

q: جِيرَانُنَا الْجُدُدُ لَمْ ___ أَحَدًا فِي الْحَيِّ بَعْدُ.
e: Our new neighbours haven't got to know anyone in the area yet.

q: اللَّاعِبُونَ لَمْ ___ أَيَّ مُبَارَاةٍ هَذَا الشَّهْرَ.
e: The players haven't lost a single match this month.
The workers haven't received their wages for a month.
They haven't come back from their holiday yet.
The boys didn't brush their teeth before bed.
People didn't understand what the minister said.

q: يَا بَنَاتُ، لِمَاذَا لَمْ ___ الْفَسَاتِينَ الْجَدِيدَةَ؟
e: Girls, why didn't you wear the new dresses?
You didn't eat anything at breakfast.
Students, you didn't read the whole text.

q: يَا صَدِيقَاتِي، لِمَاذَا لَمْ ___ لِي صُوَرَ الْحَفْلَةِ؟
e: My friends, why didn't you send me the photos from the party?
You haven't answered my question yet.
The girls haven't come back from school yet.
The nurses didn't sleep all night.
Her friends didn't come to her wedding.
They didn't win the competition this year.
The students didn't use dictionaries in the lesson.
The two boys haven't woken up yet.
You two didn't thank your mother for the food.
The two brothers haven't spoken for years.
